_comment: SOLE-WRITER REGISTER for the delivery_pathways table
this is a boundary, not a blessing. Exactly ONE module may construct
a DeliveryPathway row or write delivery_pathways via SQL — the
plasticity fold, where the decision rule, the exploration floor, the
tier-2 countersign guard, and the audit logging all live. A second
writer would be a delivery-policy mutation that skips all four.
Pathway state is derived signal: recomputable from episode logs and
attribution verdicts. It is still single-writer because it ACTUATES
(it changes what future sessions see), unlike passive derived columns.

write.reason: the plasticity fold — sole writer by design, not by debt
